controls.prediction_to_refine_and_seal: Wrong sign/exponent for the negative-pair factor must fail a small full-state source or absolute normalization check.
Drop the marked pair or nonlocal contributions to a physical generator moment; detect a selected small-source/moment discrepancy.
Replace the physical clock/source by a uniform quotient or boundary clock without a valid relation; refuse that as the submitted microscopic certificate.
Wrong folded central multiplicity or stationary Gibbs term must fail an exact normalization/moment check.
Bounded waits must retain the tanh factor; a nondivergent wait cannot be assigned the saturated limiting coefficient.
A wait outside the declared uniform range or a changed cycle preparation cost must not inherit the submitted asymptotic/rate conclusion.
A nonpositive or incompatible Hankel/moment sequence must be rejected rather than assigned a spectral quadrature certificate.
Check a one-atom/degenerate spectral measure and an explicit small multi-atom measure, including endpoint equality and node placement.
Reverse a Gauss/Radau inequality or omit a KL/tail payment; expose the bad enclosure on a declared small exact/source test.

policy: Predictions refined and sealed before execution; a control that does not break as predicted is retained and reported.
